notes: Coordinates from the board's FRONT-LEFT corner seen from the top: x along the finger (0 = front/camera edge, board_length = back/antenna edge), y across the finger (0 = left edge where the switch is). Design-for-assembly board: 22.8 wide (18.0 + a 4.8 mm TOP-side connector strip on the RIGHT). Module ESP32-S3-MINI-1U 15.4x15.4x2.4 at module_xy (1.3 mm from the LEFT edge, not centred) with its u.FL end flush with the back edge; the u.FL pigtail leaves over the back edge and runs down the inside of the bay's back wall to the flex antenna, which stays >= antenna_keepout_beyond_edge_mm (5) from the cell, the LRA and any other metal. top_max_height is the mated u.FL plug (2.9), the module shield is 2.4, the four Pico-EZmate headers (connectors_top_mm) are 1.55 mated; the lid may be lower over the front strip (x < 11.1: tallest part there is FPC1 at 2.0). Bottom parts max 1.15 (SOT-23/VSSOP) - allow >= 0.35 clearance to the cell. Mic MK1 is a bottom-port part mounted on the BOTTOM side at mic_xy; its 0.6 mm port goes through the board, so the lid needs a ~0.8 mm hole straight above mic_xy. LED D1 is on top at led_xy under a 1.0-1.5 mm thinned window (~3 mm). Switch SW1 body 3.0x2.5x1.2 on the top side, plunger pointing out of the left edge at x = switch_offset; wall slot switch_slot_mm (3.4 x 1.6) centred z = board_top+0.6. Touch (touch_mm): the electrode is a 4x5 copper-foil pad on the LID UNDERSIDE at touchpad_xy under the 0.8 mm dimple; TPAD1 on the board is the landing for a conductive-foam / spring contact that the lid compresses from 3.6 to 3.2 mm (= top_parts + lid_clearance). The 8 test pads (test_pads_top_mm) are on the TOP side so the board can be flashed and probed while seated in the bay. FPC connector FPC1 (Hirose FH12 flip-lock ZIF, bottom contact) on top at x 0.5-4.5, centred on the finger axis y = W/2; the camera head sits in a pod in front of the board (see stackup.svg / pod_mm). PLUG-IN PARTS: the cell (J1), the charging-pad pigtail (J3), the LRA (J4) and the optional speaker (J5) plug into 2-pin Molex Pico-EZmate headers on the TOP in the right strip (y 17.2-21.7); each header has a 2.4 x 1.1 wire notch in the RIGHT board edge beside it (edge_notches_mm) through which the pigtail drops into the sub-board cavity. The cell lies with its tabs toward +y (cell_tab_edge) so its lead channel runs from the pocket's +y edge to the wall under J1. The charging wires come up from the two Ø1.1 channels beside the -y wall and run in a 1.2 x 0.8 groove cut into the sub-board FLOOR (floor_wire_groove_mm) forward, across the board between the cell and LRA pockets and along the +y edge to the J3 notch. Only the piezo pads BZ1a/b (optional, DNP) and the aux pads J2a/b (bench experiment) remain bare pads on the bottom (wire_pads_bottom_mm). The optional 10 mm speaker (speaker_mm) is OFF-BOARD in a pocket in the signet's RIGHT (+y) wall, grille facing +y, its pigtail entering the sub-board cavity through that wall and rising through the J5 notch; the amp (U10) and its load switch (U11) are bottom-side parts in the back-left block. stack_mm and pod_mm carry the enclosure's as-built numbers (cell pocket 3.4 deep, lid top 11.1, pod roof flush with the lid, bore 4.6).
ufl_end_rule: no copper keep-out (MINI-1U has no PCB antenna): module GND/3V3/EN pads + GND pour; no DVP/XCLK/PCLK/PDM traces, no part other than U1; pigtail exits over the back edge
antenna_rule: flex antenna + pigtail >= 5 mm from the cell, the LRA and any other metal; down the inside of the back wall, then along the band

fpc_connector_mm.part: Hirose FH12-24S-0.5SH(55), 0.5 mm, 24 pos, bottom contact, flip-lock ZIF, 2.0 mm (LCSC C202112); alt. Amphenol FCI F32R-1A7H1-11024 slider ZIF

touch_mm.contact: conductive-foam block (or SMT spring finger) on TPAD1, free height 3.6, compressed to top_parts + lid_clearance
touch_mm.lid_electrode: copper foil 0.05-0.07 mm with conductive adhesive (3M 1181 class), cut 4 x 5 mm stuck to the lid UNDERSIDE, centred on touchpad_xy
touch_mm.dielectric_note: lid 1.2 minus the 0.4 touch dimple = 0.8 mm resin between the foil and the finger

antenna_cavity_mm.note: bay interior extends behind the board's back edge for the u.FL pigtail turn and the flex antenna glued to the back wall

speaker_mm.part: PUI Audio AS01008MR-2-R — Ø10 x 2.9 mm max, 8 Ω, 300 mW rated / 500 mW max, 86 dB, top port, NdFeB magnet, solder-pad terminals (netlist LS1, off-board; alt. any 10 mm 8 Ω micro speaker); its two leads end in a Pico-EZmate plug
speaker_mm.frame: board: x from the front edge, y from the left (switch) edge, z from the board TOP (+ toward the lid); CAD X = L/2 - x, Y = y - W/2, Z = z_board_top + z
speaker_mm.disc_plane: xz (the speaker stands vertically in the right wall)
speaker_mm.grille: Ø0.8 holes on a 1.2 mm grid inside Ø8 on the +y face, or 3 slots 0.8 x 6; 1.0 mm wall
speaker_mm.back_volume: open into the bay: remove the +y bay wall over the pocket outline above the sub-board floor (z_floor 4.6 .. pocket top 8.7 above the skin) so the bay is the back volume and the leads pass straight through; below the floor the pocket is a recess in the solid slab. Sealed alternative: keep the 1.2 wall with a 3 x 1.5 wire slot + 3 x Ø1.0 vents into the sub-board cavity and move the speaker out so its back sits 0.2 outside the old face (bump 4.3 mm)

connector.note: Pico-EZmate header on the board TOP in the right strip; the speaker pigtail comes through the wall opening into the sub-board cavity and up through the 2.4 x 1.1 edge notch beside J5

speaker_mm.wire_exit: two 28 AWG pigtail wires from the speaker's back terminals, -y through the wall opening into the sub-board cavity, up the J5 edge notch (board x 21.8) to the J5 header on the board top (<= 10 mm)
speaker_mm.antenna_clearance_note: speaker back-left corner to the flex antenna: >= 5.3 along x plus the +y offset of the pocket — the CAD fit check measures the 3-D gap (keep-out 5.0)
speaker_mm.why_not_left_wall: switch key at board x 6.3-9.7 and the pad-wire channels at board x 14.75/16.75 push a 10.4 mm pocket behind x 17.7, whose back end is 0.7 mm from the flex antenna plane
speaker_mm.why_not_band_side: 1.2 mm band wall with the finger behind it; no lead path except outside the band
